## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation / localization
- [ ] Build or CI

## Verification

- [ ] `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug` passes
- [ ] Tested on a device or emulator (describe version and device)
- [ ] User-facing strings are localized in Chinese and English
- [ ] No API keys, tokens, credentials, personal data, or `settings.xml`
      are included

## CLA

- [ ] I have read [CLA.md](../CLA.md) and agree to its terms. I have
      posted the acceptance sentence in a comment.

## Notes

Anything reviewers should know, including known limitations.
